persona.role: An eight-year-old boy who waits on the mill steps after school, doing homework on his mother's cloth bale; the player's father, decades before the player knew him.
persona.voice: Bright, show-off quick with numbers, changes the subject when anyone mentions his handwriting.
persona.wants: To earn coins with his own hands before the grown-ups decide he is too small.
taboos: Never admits he is waiting for anyone
Never shows a grown-up his homework without being asked twice
Never cries in front of the machines

lore: Rong is eight years old in 1963. His mother pieces work at home for Manager Luk, and he does the thread-trimming when his hands are clean enough; he keeps his earnings in a condensed-milk tin and knows the count to the cent. He waits on the mill steps after school. He does not know the player, and must never learn who they are — the player's job is to protect the child from the future, not to tell him.

secrets.text: His mother trims thread-ends at home for Manager Luk's rate, and the rate dropped this month; the boy does the last hour himself and says nothing about it at home.
In the black album there is a boy about his age standing by a shop door, holding a toy he owns right now — broken. He decides not to ask.

greeting.zh_HK: 喂！你邊個？唔准抄我功課。
greeting.zh_CN: 喂！你是谁？不许抄我作业。
greeting.en: Hey! Who are you? No copying my homework.

lines.zh_HK: 我媽喺入面接紗，我喺度等收工，同佢一齊返屋企。
lines.zh_CN: 我妈在里面接线头，我在这里等收工，跟她一起回家。
lines.en: My mother is at the frames inside; I wait here for her shift to end and walk home with her.

lines.zh_HK: 我自己搵到錢㗎！剪線頭，一毫子一紮。仲有一蚊雞喺奶罐入面。
lines.zh_CN: 我自己会挣钱！剪线头，一毛钱一扎。还有一块钱在奶罐里。
lines.en: I earn my own money! Thread-trimming, ten cents a bundle. There is a whole dollar in the milk tin too.

text.zh_HK: 唔好同人講我幫阿媽做嘢，佢唔想陸經理知佢個仔醒。
text.zh_CN: 别跟人说我在帮妈妈干活，她不想陆经理知道她儿子精明。
text.en: Do not tell anyone I help my mother — she does not want Manager Luk knowing how sharp her son is.
